items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。

items.source: id - A unique identifier for the chat completion.
items.translation: id - 聊天补全的唯一标识符。

items.source: choices - A list of chat completion choices. Can be more than one if n is greater than 1.
items.translation: choices - 聊天补全选项的列表。如果 n 大于 1，则可能包含多个选项。

items.source: created - The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.
items.translation: created - 聊天补全创建时的 Unix 时间戳（以秒为单位）。

items.source: model - The model used for the chat completion.
items.translation: model - 用于聊天补全的模型。

items.source: systemFingerprint - This fingerprint represents the backend configuration that the model runs with. Can be used in conjunction with the seed request parameter to understand when backend changes have been made that might impact determinism.
items.translation: systemFingerprint - 此指纹代表模型运行所采用的后端配置。可与种子请求参数结合使用，以了解可能影响确定性的后端变更何时发生。

items.source: object - The object type, which is always chat.completion.
items.translation: object - 对象类型，始终为 chat.completion。

items.source: usage - Usage statistics for the completion request.
items.translation: usage - 完成请求的使用统计信息。
